chunks: Then one turned to the other in an enquiry.

key_terms.بَعْضُهُمْ: some of them / one of them
key_terms.يَتَسَاءَلُونَ: they ask each other / mutual inquiry

ai.seo_question: What does the Quran describe when people turn to each other to ask questions?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this phrase often captures the moment of realization or regret among the disbelievers or hypocrites as they confront the consequences of their actions, turning to one another in futile inquiry. It underscores the social dynamics of accountability, where individuals seek clarification or justification from their peers when faced with divine judgment. This interaction serves as a microcosm of the broader theme of communal responsibility and the eventual reckoning of deeds.
